read_this_first: Rows are only comparable within the same media_class and the same tenant conditions.
class A media = HEVC Main 10 >= 8128x4288, 29.97-class rate, 3840x1520 timeline (see bench/resolve-agentic/MEDIA.md).
Render ms are single-tenant; two-agent waves inflate them (a 7285 ms T7 render ran alongside another agent's Fusion work).
Every number here came from an independent read-back (ffprobe / item geometry / server operation log), never from the agent's report.

resolve_mcp.notes: Warm engine before scoring. Contamination hard-sealed from run 2 (memory dir + this doc moved off-disk). probe_timeline_structure regressed 7->11 ms; everything else improved.

Cold 1668 is host state (page cache), not an MCP win: 4.19.x never touches the render path. Warm 1196 equals the best prior mark. No n=3 agentic re-run: the bump was behaviour-free (upstream fix of the CLAP audio-embedding bug, verified by direct probe).

deviations: T7 briefs allow exactly one shell command (mkdir of the render target dir) - the render tools refuse a non-existent target_dir; file verification stays on the MCP side

operator graded run-1 pair 3 while an agent was still live, on a premature finish notice, and mistook a transient state for a failed trial; the pair is clean and scored, and the rule is now no operator Resolve calls until every agent reports
sealing is procedural (no harness-enforced tool ban): repo and memory dirs moved off-disk for the wave, operator transcripts stay on disk
tool counts come from the harness usage block; the MCP operation log records mutating ops only (no params) and was used for ordering evidence
